details.about: Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform used by millions of companies, from the largest enterprises to ambitious startups, to accept payments and grow revenue; its mission is to increase the GDP of the internet. This Core Technology engineer works on the foundational platform services behind Stripe's large internal engineering ecosystem. Multiple positions are available.
duties: Architect and maintain foundational platform services that drive reliability, efficiency and developer productivity across Stripe's internal engineering ecosystem
Work with internal stakeholders to align roadmap planning with long-term infrastructure health
Keep availability high by debugging complex production issues across services and levels of the stack
Build a fast inner development loop and resource-efficient environments for deploying everything from low-latency microservices to large data pipelines and machine learning models
needs: Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Engineering or a related field plus 3 years of software development experience, or a Master's degree or foreign equivalent plus 1 year
1 year writing high-quality code in Go, Java or C/C++
1 year developing scalable microservice backend systems in Ruby and Java
1 year implementing resiliency patterns (networking strategies, retries, rate limits, circuit breakers) and tuning systems for low latency
1 year using observability tools including Prometheus and building framework-level observability
1 year writing modular, testable infrastructure algorithms, including retry logic with exponential backoff
1 year with distributed systems and caching technologies including Redis, and data structures such as thread-safe concurrent hash maps
1 year with at least three of: API, REST, SOAP, Agile, Jira, Git, AngularJS, Node.js, Cloud or Java
details.benefits: Base salary $165,131 – $235,200 a year; any sales commissions or bonus targets would be on top. Additional benefits may include equity, a company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses, a 401(k) plan, medical, dental and vision benefits, and wellness stipends.

scenes.head: About Stripe

Mission: grow the GDP of the internet
lines: Stripe is the financial infrastructure platform that millions of companies, from global enterprises to new startups, use to accept payments and grow their revenue.
This team builds the foundational platform services that Stripe's own engineers rely on every day.

scenes.head: What you'll do
bullets: Build a fast inner dev loop
lines: You'll architect and maintain the core platform services that make Stripe's engineering more reliable, efficient, and productive.
You'll work with internal teams to align their roadmaps with long-term infrastructure health.
You'll debug complex production issues across services and layers of the stack.
And you'll build a fast development loop and efficient environments for deploying everything from low-latency microservices to data pipelines and machine learning models.
